title: Aetheria — Immersive WebGL Spatial Platform
problem: The client needed a groundbreaking interactive web showroom to unveil an upcoming product line without requiring heavy app downloads or compromising graphical fidelity.
solution: Engineered a custom lightweight 3D engine on top of Three.js and bespoke GLSL post-processing shaders, achieving 60fps rendering across desktop and mobile devices with progressive asset streaming.
outcome: Over 350,000 unique interactive sessions in launch month with an average dwell time of 4.8 minutes, increasing customer pre-orders by 142%.
role: Creative Direction, Technical Art & WebGL Engineering

title: NeuroSim — Physics-Based Medical Simulation
problem: Traditional medical training relied on costly physical models with limited repeatability and no real-time telemetry on procedural accuracy.
solution: Developed a high-precision physics simulation engine reproducing soft tissue mechanics and surgical instrument haptics, deployed via WebAssembly for frictionless browser access.
outcome: Adopted by 12 medical institutions for surgical residency training, reducing preparation time by 35% while increasing procedural confidence scores.

title: Chronos — Real-time WebXR Product Configurator
problem: Complex bespoke hardware with thousands of customization configurations suffered from low conversion due to static 2D preview renders.
solution: Created an instant-load WebXR augmented reality configurator with micro-surface metallic sheen shaders, dynamic environment lighting, and real-time AR room projection.
outcome: Reduced product return rate by 28% and elevated user interaction time by 4x compared to traditional e-commerce galleries.

title: OmniFlow — Industrial Digital Twin & Data Viz
problem: Industrial operators faced delayed incident response due to fragmented tabular data streams across multiple automated warehouses.
solution: Built a synchronous 3D digital twin platform rendering thousands of concurrent robotic units and conveyor belts live with sub-second telemetry synchronization.
outcome: Reduced operational downtime by 22% and allowed remote site managers to diagnose bottlenecks within seconds.

title: EduQuest — STEM Interactive Learning Suite
problem: Low student engagement in secondary school STEM topics using conventional static e-learning materials.
solution: Designed and engineered an episodic interactive gamification suite where students solve interactive physics, chemistry, and algorithmic puzzles directly in their browsers.
outcome: Deployed to over 80,000 active students, showing a 47% increase in topic retention and 91% student completion rate.
role: Game Design, Interactive Engineering & Educational Logic

title: VoxelCraft — Procedural World Engine & Tech Art
problem: Generating infinite diverse natural terrains at runtime with dynamic destructibility while maintaining 60fps on consumer web browsers.
solution: Architected a multithreaded procedural generation pipeline in Rust compiled to WebAssembly with GPU geometry instancing and chunk caching.
outcome: Capable of rendering 100,000+ active chunks with seamless Level-of-Detail (LOD) transitions and zero stutter during traversal.
role: Core Engine Architecture & Technical Art Pipeline
